places.name: Key Monastery (Ki Gompa)
places.description: The most iconic and architecturally spectacular monastery in Spiti — the building itself seems to defy both gravity and time.
places.mapsSearch: Key Monastery Ki Gompa Spiti Valley Himachal Pradesh
places.bestTime: June to October; Gustor festival for ceremonial dances

places.name: Tabo Monastery
places.description: India's oldest active monastery with 1,000-year-old frescoes — the most significant Buddhist art site in the entire Himalayan region.
places.mapsSearch: Tabo Monastery Spiti Valley Himachal Pradesh
places.bestTime: May to October; Buddha Jayanti celebrations are particularly atmospheric

places.name: Chandratal Lake
places.description: One of the highest and most beautiful lakes in India — the night sky from Chandratal's shores is virtually unmatched anywhere in the country.
places.mapsSearch: Chandratal Lake Spiti Valley Himachal Pradesh
places.bestTime: July to mid-September (road opens after snowmelt; closes by October)

places.name: Kaza Town
places.description: The pulse of Spiti Valley — the essential base camp for all major attractions, with genuine high-altitude Tibetan frontier town character.
places.mapsSearch: Kaza Town Spiti Valley Himachal Pradesh

places.name: Hikkim Village and World's Highest Post Office
places.description: Send a postcard from the world's highest post office — a small, completely unique experience in the heart of Spiti.
places.mapsSearch: Hikkim Post Office Spiti Valley Himachal Pradesh highest

places.name: Komic Village
places.description: Standing in a functioning village above 4,500 metres — growing crops, sustaining a monastery, living at an altitude most aircraft cruise below.
places.mapsSearch: Komic Village Spiti Valley highest village motorable road

places.name: Langza Village and Fossil Hill
places.description: Fossils from a 50-million-year-old seabed at 4,400 metres — Langza is one of the most mind-bending geology field sites on earth.
places.mapsSearch: Langza Village Buddha fossil Spiti Valley Himachal Pradesh

places.name: Kunzum Pass
places.description: The high-altitude threshold of the Spiti world — a ceremony of arrival and departure with one of the most formidable mountain panoramas in India.
places.mapsSearch: Kunzum Pass Spiti Valley Himachal Pradesh
places.bestTime: July to mid-September when the road is clear

places.name: Dhankar Monastery and Lake
places.description: The most precariously and dramatically situated monastery in the world — a mud-brick fortress on a blade of rock over a river confluence.
places.mapsSearch: Dhankar Monastery Lake Spiti Valley Himachal Pradesh

places.name: Pin Valley National Park
places.description: The highest chance of sighting wild snow leopards in India — winter trips to Pin Valley are considered among the world's premium wildlife experiences.
places.mapsSearch: Pin Valley National Park Spiti Himachal Pradesh
places.bestTime: November to February for snow leopard sightings; June to September for general wildlife
